candidates.title: Online Talk and Demo : The Context Layer for a Grounded Data Agent
candidates.description:
C.O.D.E - Community of Developers & Engineers
**Abstract**
Data agents are most useful when they understand the data they work with, not only its structure. This talk explores how a context layer helps an agent make better decisions and write accurate SQL that stays grounded in the business. We will look at the building blocks of context, including ontology and a context graph, and how they come together so an agent can retrieve what is relevant, reason over it, check its own work and respond with confidence. We will also cover how to measure the incremental changes with evaluations. Attendees…
